resources.string: A few settings so the alarm reaches you even when the screen is locked. You can catch up on anything missing later in Settings.
For the alarm and the running infusion.
So Android doesn\'t put the timer to sleep. On Samsung devices, also add UmamiT to “Never sleeping apps”.
Shows the infusion in the status bar and on the lock screen.
Shows the alarm over the lock screen.
Samsung sometimes restarts the phone at night. Afterwards a running timer only rings once you\'ve unlocked the phone. Under Battery and device care › Automatic optimization, turn off “Auto restart”.
Couldn\'t save. Tap again; is the storage full?
Make all teas from Tee-Kontor Kiel available offline, from green tea to chai. The first load takes about half an hour; you can use the app in the meantime.
The catalog keeps loading in the background, even with the phone locked. You can get started already.
Loading cancelled. You can load the catalog later under Collection › Catalog.
The catalog couldn\'t be loaded just now. You can try again later under Collection › Catalog.
Tap a tea under Recently brewed or start a New session. The timer guides you through every infusion, with a pre-alert and an alarm.
Two timers can run at once: two sessions, or a session and the quick timer. The row at the top switches to the other timer.
Load the Tee-Kontor Kiel catalog and add teas to My teas, or share a shop link with UmamiT. Recipes, stock and costs live on the tea.
Every session lands in the journal. Rate the tea and the brewing, note the taste of each infusion and keep good times in the recipe.
See what you drink: sessions, kinds, favourite teas, habits, use and cost per litre.
In Settings › Data & backup you save all your data to one file. Share a recipe from ⋮ in the recipe.

Add a tea without the catalog
For teas from other shops or gifts
For teas that are not in the Tee-Kontor Kiel catalog, e.g. from another shop or a gift.
Open Collection › My teas and tap ⋮ › Add a tea without the catalog.
Under Choose variety, pick the variety, e.g. Sencha. If none fits, take Andere / unbekannt. The variety brings a matching default recipe.
Enter a name under New tea. Everything else is optional: origin, vendor, freshness and notes.
Enter Package and Price under Purchase, and UmamiT keeps track of stock and cost.
Tap Save. Add a photo afterwards on the tea with + Photo.
Add a tea from a shop link
Load one Tee-Kontor Kiel tea directly
Get one tea from Tee-Kontor Kiel without loading the whole catalog.
Open the tea\'s page in the browser, tap Share there and pick UmamiT.
Or copy the link, tap ⋮ › Paste link in Collection › Catalog, then Load tea.
UmamiT loads only that one page and shows the tea. Tap Add to collection.
Pick the Package, check Price and Purchase date, and tap Add.
If the tea is already in your collection, the sheet reads Log a repurchase and logs one.
Load the whole catalog in Catalog with ⋮ › Update catalog.
Purchases, stock and what a liter costs
UmamiT takes the leaf of every session off your stock and works out what your tea costs.
Open the tea in My teas. Stock shows how much is left, and below it the price per 100 g and what a liter costs.
Bought more? Tap Log a repurchase and enter amount, price and purchase date.
If the stock is off, tap Correct stock and enter what is left. 0 g means the tea is empty.
A typo? Tap a Purchase or Stock corrected row in the history below, change it and tap Save. The costs of earlier sessions are worked out again.
In Settings › Brewing & stock you set when a tea runs low (Low from) and when the Stock reminder comes. Deduct stock turns the deduction off.
Your own recipes, steps, sharing and receiving
Each tea has a default recipe and up to ten recipes in all.
Open the tea and tap Add recipe under Recipes, or the pencil next to a recipe.
Set the method, vessel, leaf, water, temperature and pre-alert. As default makes it the recipe the tea starts with.
Each step has a duration and a temperature. Its kind is Infusion, Rinse or Whisk; Add infusion adds one. Then Save.
Sharing: in a saved recipe, ⋮ › Share recipe. It sends a text and a recipe file.
Receiving: tap the file, share it with UmamiT or use My teas › ⋮ › Import recipe. In Take over recipe you pick the tea.
After a session UmamiT offers Save times to the recipe when you brewed differently.
Vessel, changing steps, two timers, quick timer
From the first tap to the last infusion, and what you can change on the way.
On Start, tap Start brewing and pick a tea. A tea under Recently brewed goes straight to the timer, with last time\'s values.
In New session, pick the Vessel: water and leaf follow. Keep ratio keeps the ratio when you change one. Then Start session.
In the timer: Start, and after the alarm Poured. The next infusion waits until you start it.
Change it on the way: ⋮ › Edit steps or Another infusion. At the end, End session saves it all to the journal.
Two timers: meanwhile, start a second session or the Quick timer. The row below the picture shows the other timer; a tap switches to it.
The Quick timer on Start needs no tea: tap the duration, Start.
Manage your vessels in Settings › Teaware.
Ratings, taste, times into the recipe
Every session lands in the journal by itself. This is how you note how it was.
After End session, Saved to the journal appears: give stars for Tea and Brewing.
Already in the timer, the button “Taste · Infusion 1” opens the sliders for that infusion after pouring off.
Later, open the session in the Journal. Add taste sets the sliders per infusion; + Descriptor adds matching words.
Were your times different from the recipe? Save times to the recipe keeps them.
⋮ › Edit corrects date, amounts and times; the stock follows.
Brew this again starts a new session with exactly these values.
Back up, restore, CSV, delete all
Your data stays on your phone. A backup takes it to a new phone or brings it back.
Create backup writes teas, journal, photos and settings to one file. You choose where it goes, e.g. your cloud.
Remind me to back up speaks up when many sessions have been added since the last backup.
Restore backup replaces all data with the file; you confirm with REPLACE. For a while afterwards, Undo restore is still there.
Journal as CSV exports your journal as a table.
Delete all data resets the app, confirmed with DELETE. Back up first!
While a timer runs, restoring and deleting are not possible.
So the alarm rings even with the screen locked and after a long wait.
At the top of Settings, Timer reliability shows whether all is set. For a marked item, Fix opens the right system page.
What matters: Notifications, Full-screen alarm, Battery: Unrestricted and Exact alarms.
After an app update Android often turns the full-screen alarm off. UmamiT then asks with Allow the full-screen alarm again: tap Allow.
If Start shows The timer may be unreliable, tap Fix.
In Timer & alarm, Test alarm plays the pre-alert and the alarm. Ring under “Do Not Disturb” lets the alarm through in Do Not Disturb.
On Samsung phones, turn off the automatic overnight restart (device care): after a restart the alarm rings only once the phone is unlocked.
